cna.title: Open WebUI: Instance-wide stall via automation recurrence rules that force multi-second parsing

descriptions.value: Open WebUI is an extensible, feature-rich, and user-friendly self-hosted AI platform. From 0.9.0 until 0.11.0, automation recurrence parsing in backend/open_webui/utils/automations.py anchored minutely and hourly rules at a fixed date of 2000-01-01 and then walked forward one interval at a time to find the next run. A single FREQ=MINUTELY rule enumerates roughly a quarter-century of occurrences synchronously on the event loop that also serves scheduler, HTTP, and WebSocket traffic, and the scheduler recomputes the next run for every claimed row on each poll. This causes availability impact for every other user of the instance. This issue is fixed in 0.11.0.

cna.title: Flowise: Pyodide validator Unicode homoglyph bypass leads to RCE

descriptions.value: Flowise is a drag & drop user interface to build a customized large language model flow. Prior to 3.1.3, Flowise validatePythonCodeForDataFrame in packages/components/src/pythonCodeValidator.ts can be bypassed with Unicode homoglyph identifiers, allowing arbitrary Python execution inside Pyodide and full OS command execution on the Flowise host via Pyodide js module interop. The validator gates pyodide.runPythonAsync in packages/components/nodes/agents/CSVAgent/CSVAgent.ts and packages/components/nodes/agents/AirtableAgent/AirtableAgent.ts with an ASCII word-boundary blacklist. JavaScript regex word boundaries are ASCII-only, while Python 3 NFKC-normalizes identifiers at parse time, so homoglyph forms such as __cl𝐚ss__, __subcl𝐚sses__, __b𝐚se__, and __b𝐮iltins__ bypass the blacklist and are parsed as their ASCII equivalents. This issue is fixed in version 3.1.3.

cna.title: tar-rs 0.4.11 - 0.4.46 Symlink Escape via append_dir_all()

descriptions.value: tar-rs versions 0.4.11 through 0.4.46 contain a symlink escape vulnerability in the Builder::append_dir_all() function that allows attackers to read files outside the intended source root directory by planting symlinks in an attacker-controlled directory. When a privileged process archives an untrusted directory, the function follows symlinks without verifying that resolved targets remain within the source root, causing out-of-bounds files to be included in the archive as regular files and disclosed to the attacker.

cna.title: Electron: Off-screen rendering trusts GPU-supplied geometry over shared-memory size

descriptions.value: Electron is a framework for writing cross-platform desktop applications using JavaScript, HTML and CSS. Prior to 39.8.10, 40.9.0, 41.2.1, and 42.0.0-beta.3, offscreen rendering frame data received from the GPU process was not fully validated by the main process. A compromised GPU process could cause the main process to read out-of-bounds memory while producing paint event images, disclosing memory or crashing the app. This issue is fixed in 39.8.10, 40.9.0, 41.2.1, and 42.0.0-beta.3.

cna.title: Electron: contextBridge object copy honors prototype setters

descriptions.description: CWE-1321: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')

descriptions.value: Electron is a framework for writing cross-platform desktop applications using JavaScript, HTML and CSS. Prior to 39.8.9, 40.9.2, 41.2.2, and 42.0.0-beta.4, objects copied across the contextBridge boundary from untrusted content could carry an attacker-influenced prototype, enabling prototype-pollution-style attacks against preload code despite context isolation being enabled. Apps are only affected if their preload code accepts object arguments from untrusted content and reads properties from them without own-property checks, while apps that only accept primitive arguments or validate object arguments are not affected. This issue is fixed in 39.8.9, 40.9.2, 41.2.2, and 42.0.0-beta.4.

cna.title: libvips: Possible integer overflow when reading multi-page TIFF images via ImageMagick

descriptions.value: libvips is a fast image processing library with low memory needs. Prior to version 8.18.3, libvips built without libtiff support but with ImageMagick support can overflow the combined frame height while loading a crafted multi-page TIFF through VipsForeignLoadMagick. The vulnerable calculations in libvips/foreign/magick6load.c and libvips/foreign/magick7load.c multiply the per-page Ysize by n_frames without a checked bound, which can cause a heap buffer over-read and process crash. Most package-manager builds include libtiff and do not use this affected fallback path. This issue is fixed in version 8.18.3.

Prior to 39.8.8, 40.9.0, 41.2.1, and 42.0.0-beta.3, extension tab and scripting APIs were not scoped to the extension's own session. A malicious or compromised extension loaded into one session could navigate, script, and read from windows belonging to a different session. Apps are only affected if they load Chrome extensions via session.loadExtension and rely on separate sessions to isolate that extension from other content. This issue is fixed in versions 39.8.8, 40.9.0, 41.2.1, and 42.0.0-beta.3.

cna.title: rsync 2.3.3 < 3.5.0 Path Traversal via --partial-dir/--backup-dir Symlink

descriptions.value: rsync 2.3.3 before 3.5.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows a malicious sender to escape the module root by exploiting symlinks within the module file tree when using --partial-dir or --backup-dir options. Attackers with write access to place a symlink under the module root, or who can exploit a pre-existing trusted symlink, can direct file writes to locations outside the intended module root, achieving arbitrary file write relative to the module root parent.

descriptions.value: llama.cpp builds b1886 through b7445 contain a null pointer dereference vulnerability in the LLaMA-Android JNI wrapper where the bench_1model() function fails to validate the model context pointer before dereferencing it. cna.title: Checkmate: Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS) via User-Controlled Regex in Monitor Advanced Matching

descriptions.value: Checkmate is an open-source, self-hosted tool designed to track and monitor server hardware, uptime, response times, and incidents in real-time with beautiful visualizations. From 3.5.1 until 3.9.2, an authenticated admin or superadmin can set matchMethod to regex and place a malicious expression in the expectedValue field for advanced HTTP monitor matching. server/src/api/validation/monitorValidation.ts accepts the expression, and server/src/service/network/AdvancedMatcher.ts synchronously evaluates it against an attacker-controlled HTTP response body on the Node.js main event loop without a timeout or worker isolation, allowing catastrophic backtracking to freeze API endpoints, monitor checks, and WebSocket connections for all users. This issue is fixed in version 3.9.2.

cna.title: Open WebUI: Unapproved accounts can open terminal sessions via a WebSocket auth path missing the role check

descriptions.value: Open WebUI is an extensible, feature-rich, and user-friendly self-hosted AI platform. From 0.8.8 until 0.11.0, the terminal WebSocket route in backend/open_webui/routers/terminals.py authenticated its own first-message JWT and never applied the verified-user role gate that get_verified_user enforces on HTTP terminal routes. An account whose role is pending, including a registered but unapproved account or an account deactivated back to pending, can open an interactive terminal session when at least one terminal server is configured and its access grants cover the account. This loses the account-approval boundary for terminal access while the HTTP terminal routes correctly reject the same account. This issue is fixed in 0.11.0.

cna.title: Flowise: RBAC Bypass Leading to Unauthorized Workspace Variables Disclosure

descriptions.value: Flowise is a drag-and-drop user interface for building customized large language model (LLM) flows. Prior to 3.1.3, Flowise injects $vars into the code execution sandbox without requiring variables:view, bypassing the permission-protected Variables API. Variables for the active workspace are fetched at packages/components/src/utils.ts and runtime variables are resolved from server environment variables, while the official variables route enforces variables:view. A user or API key that is denied variables:view can call /api/v1/node-custom-function and receive $vars pre-populated with all variables for the workspace, including Variable.name to Variable.value static variables and Variable.name to process.env[Variable.name] runtime variables. This can expose secrets such as database passwords, JWT secrets, SMTP passwords, and cloud keys, depending on the workspace Variables configuration. This issue is fixed in version 3.1.3.

cna.title: Flowise: Cross-workspace credential IDOR in openai-assistants-vector-store

descriptions.value: Flowise is a drag & drop user interface to build a customized large language model flow. Prior to 3.1.3, Flowise openai-assistants-vector-store endpoints accept a client-controlled credential parameter and load credentials by id without checking whether that credential belongs to the caller workspace. Route permissions assistants:* only check feature access. The controller passes req.query.credential straight to the service, and the service uses findOneBy({ id: credentialId }), decrypts the credential, and calls OpenAI APIs without a workspaceId check. If an attacker knows another workspace credentialId, the attacker can use that workspace OpenAI key, read, modify, or delete victim vector stores and files, cause billing impact on the victim OpenAI account, and violate multi-tenant boundaries. This issue is fixed in version 3.1.3.

cna.title: Open WebUI: Stored XSS via unescaped KaTeX render-error fallback in rendered messages

descriptions.value: Open WebUI is an extensible, feature-rich, and user-friendly self-hosted AI platform. From 0.10.0 until 0.11.0, src/lib/components/chat/Messages/Markdown/KatexRenderer.svelte could store and render a chat message whose math block makes KaTeX fail with a stack overflow instead of a parse error. The catch branch fell back to inserting the original math source into the page as HTML through {@html} rather than as text, so script in the message runs in the browser of whoever views it, including shared chats and channels. The viewer's session token in localStorage can be stolen, and an administrator viewer can have their account taken over. This issue is fixed in 0.11.0.

cna.title: imagecli - Negative carve Ratio Bypasses Bounds Check and Crashes Process via Reachable Panic

descriptions.value: imagecli's pipeline operation (Carve::apply in src/image_ops.rs) only asserts , never validating that the ratio is positive. A negative ratio (e.g. -5) causes the computed target width to saturate to 0 via Rust's defined float-to-uint cast, which is then passed to imageproc::seam_carving::shrink_width — a function that panics when given a width below 2, crashing the process.

cna.title: Hubzilla version prior to 11.4 CSRF via OAuth2 /authorize Endpoint App Registration

descriptions.value: Hubzilla  versions prior to 11.4 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the OAuth2 /authorize endpoint handled by Zotlabs\Module\Authorize::post() that allows unauthenticated attackers to register arbitrary OAuth2 applications under an authenticated user's account by submitting a cross-origin POST request without CSRF token or Origin/Referer validation. Attackers can craft a malicious HTML form that autosubmits attacker-chosen OAuth2 parameters including client_id, client_secret, redirect_uri, and scope to silently register a persistent OAuth2 application, enabling interception of future OAuth2 authorization codes when the victim later authenticates against the attacker-controlled client.

cna.title: Electron: Permission Check Handler Receives Main Frame Origin Instead of Requesting Iframe Origin

descriptions.value: Electron is a framework for writing cross-platform desktop applications using JavaScript, HTML and CSS. Prior to 39.8.7, 40.9.0, 41.2.0, and 42.0.0-beta.1, serial-port and media permission checks made from an iframe passed the top-level frame origin to session.setPermissionCheckHandler instead of the requesting iframe origin. Origin-based handler logic could grant a cross-origin iframe device access intended only for the top-level origin. This issue is fixed in 39.8.7, 40.9.0, 41.2.0, and 42.0.0-beta.1.

cna.title: aiosend: Deserialization of request body before signature verification (Pre-auth DoS) in webhook handler

descriptions.value: aiosend is a synchronous and asynchronous Crypto Pay API client. Pror to version 3.0.7, `WebhookHandler.feed_update()` deserializes the entire request body before verifying the HMAC signature. This allows an unauthenticated attacker to force expensive parsing of arbitrary JSON payloads that will ultimately be rejected, leading to unnecessary CPU and memory consumption. Version 3.0.7 fixes the issue. Some workarounds are available. Restrict request body size at the reverse proxy or web framework, rate-limit webhook endpoints, and/or reject oversized requests before JSON parsing.

cna.title: Electron: window.open features string controls some window options considered privileged

descriptions.value: Electron is a framework for writing cross-platform desktop applications using JavaScript, HTML and CSS. Prior to 39.8.8, 40.9.0, 41.2.1, and 42.0.0-beta.3, some window options supplied by web content in the window.open() features string were applied to the new BrowserWindow without an allowlist. Untrusted content could set window options it should not control, including options that cause the main process to access attacker-chosen file or network paths, when untrusted content can call window.open() and the app does not override child window options via setWindowOpenHandler or overrideBrowserWindowOptions. This issue is fixed in 39.8.8, 40.9.0, 41.2.1, and 42.0.0-beta.3.

cna.title: Electron: ProtocolResponse.url reuses the default session cache instead of the registering session

descriptions.value: Electron is a framework for writing cross-platform desktop applications using JavaScript, HTML and CSS. Prior to 40.10.6, 41.9.1, 42.5.1, and 43.0.0, when a custom protocol handler returned a ProtocolResponse with a url and no session, Electron made the upstream request through defaultSession instead of the session that handled the protocol. A cached response could then be reused across otherwise isolated session partitions. Apps that use ProtocolResponse.url, omit ProtocolResponse.session, and rely on separate sessions to isolate content are affected. This issue is fixed in versions 40.10.6, 41.9.1, 42.5.1, and 43.0.0.

cna.title: diboot-core Authenticated Arbitrary Field Read via loadRelatedData Discloses Password Hashes and Salts

descriptions.value: diboot-core's POST /common/load-related-data endpoint resolves caller-supplied field names to any @TableField column of any entity and returns those values for all rows, with no field or entity allowlist. The only guard, relatedDataSecurityCheck(), returns true unconditionally, so any authenticated user (including a zero-role account) can read @JsonIgnore-annotated secret fields such as IamAccount.authSecret and IamAccount.secretSalt for every account, or arbitrary secret fields of any other entity. Shiro's two-iteration MD5 with an 8-character salt is trivially crackable offline, so the disclosed admin password hashes convert to full administrative takeover. The endpoint is not example code; the official diboot-admin-ui frontend requires it, so deployments following the vendor's recommended integration expose it. The mechanism was renamed relatedData* to attachMore* on the development branch, but attachMoreSecurityCheck() also returns true unconditionally.

cna.title: Electron: HTTP redirect followed into local file loader

descriptions.value: Electron is a framework for writing cross-platform desktop applications using JavaScript, HTML and CSS. Prior to 39.8.8, 40.9.0, 41.2.1, and 42.0.0-beta.3, when following HTTP redirects, net.fetch() and net.request() did not restrict which schemes a redirect could target. A remote server could redirect a request to a local resource, and if the app returns or forwards the response body, local file contents could be disclosed. Apps are only affected if they make net requests to attacker-influenced URLs with redirects followed and expose the response body. This issue is fixed in versions 39.8.8, 40.9.0, 41.2.1, and 42.0.0-beta.3.

A user with write access to one knowledge base could delete directories and remove file embeddings from another knowledge base, causing documents to drop out of retrieval results and breaking chat-with-file for targeted documents without disclosing contents. This issue is fixed in 0.11.0.

descriptions.value: ImageMagick 7.1.0-20 before 7.1.2-32 contains an invalid memory free vulnerability in the fx operation that occurs when initialization of an FX runtime entry fails. Attackers can trigger the failed FX runtime initialization to cause an invalid free, resulting in memory corruption and application crashes.

cna.title: Zebra 6.4.0 before 6.4.2 Denial of Service via Malformed v6 Transaction

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Zebra 6.4.0 before 6.4.2 Denial of Service via Malformed v6 Transaction

descriptions.value: ZcashFoundation Zebra 6.4.0 before 6.4.2 parses version 6 transactions carrying a pre-NU6.3 consensus branch ID, but the size computation during UnminedTx construction treats re-serialization of the Orchard bundle as infallible, so the resulting error trips an expect that aborts zebrad. Unauthenticated peers can send a single pre-handshake tx message to crash the node, and can repeat this after each restart.

cna.title: Denial-of-service in the WebRTC component

credits.value: Shu Takahashi  of Velcore Consulting Inc.

descriptions.value: Denial-of-service in the WebRTC component. This vulnerability was fixed in Firefox 158, Firefox ESR 153.5, Thunderbird 158, and Thunderbird 153.5.

supportingMedia.value: Denial-of-service in the WebRTC component. This vulnerability was fixed in Firefox 158, Firefox ESR 153.5, Thunderbird 158, and Thunderbird 153.5.

cna.title: LibreNMS before 26.9.0 Path Traversal via NFSen channel Parameter

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: LibreNMS before 26.9.0 Path Traversal via NFSen channel Parameter

descriptions.value: LibreNMS before 26.9.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in nfsen_channel_common.inc.php that allows authenticated users to read unauthorized RRD data by injecting ../ sequences into the channel parameter. Attackers with access to one NFSen-enabled device can request graph.php with a traversed channel value to view traffic and NetFlow graphs of devices outside their authorized scope.

descriptions.description: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

cna.title: Admidio 4.3.2 through 4.3.17 and 5.0.0 before 5.0.15 Cross-Organization Access Control Bypass via members_assignment.php

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Admidio 4.3.2 through 4.3.17 and 5.0.0 before 5.0.15 Cross-Organization Access Control Bypass via members_assignment.php

descriptions.value: Admidio 4.3.2 through 4.3.17 and 5.0.0 before 5.0.15 contains a broken access control vulnerability that allows role administrators to assign users to roles in other organizations. Attackers can submit crafted assign requests to members_assignment.php with a foreign role UUID to gain privileged membership, log into that organization, and edit its user profiles.

cna.title: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 Memory Leak in Wavelet-Denoise Operation

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 Memory Leak in Wavelet-Denoise Operation

descriptions.value: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a memory leak in the wavelet-denoise operation, which fails to release allocated memory when a required resource cannot be acquired. Attackers can repeatedly trigger wavelet-denoise processing under resource-constrained conditions to leak memory and degrade service availability.

descriptions.description: Missing Release of Memory after Effective Lifetime

cna.title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.119.0 Stored XSS Leading to Account Takeover

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Frappe ERPNext before 15.119.0 Stored XSS Leading to Account Takeover

descriptions.value: Frappe ERPNext before 15.119.0 and 16.x before 16.31.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because record fields are rendered into an HTML attribute context without escaping. A low-privilege user can store a malicious payload in a record field that executes in the browser of any privileged user who opens the affected page, enabling account takeover.

descriptions.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

cna.title: jbardin scp.py SCP Receive _recv_pushd path traversal

references.name: VDB-416886 | jbardin scp.py SCP Receive _recv_pushd path traversal
VDB-416886 | CTI Indicators (IOB, IOC, TTP, IOA)

descriptions.value: A security vulnerability has been detected in jbardin scp.py up to 0.16.1. The impacted element is the function _recv_file/_recv_pushd of the component SCP Receive Handler. The manipulation leads to path traversal. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. Upgrading to version 0.16.2 is sufficient to resolve this issue. The identifier of the patch is 42fc3aaa71411daed60544e3b40179c1038bed5d. Upgrading the affected component is advised. The vendor was contacted early, responded in a very professional manner and quickly released a fixed version of the affected product.

cna.title: FreeRDP 2.0.0 before 3.32.0 Insecure Private Key Permissions in winpr-makecert

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: FreeRDP 2.0.0 before 3.32.0 Insecure Private Key Permissions in winpr-makecert

descriptions.value: FreeRDP from 2.0.0 before 3.32.0 contains an insecure permission vulnerability in winpr-makecert that creates unencrypted private keys without owner-only file modes. Local users on multi-user Unix hosts can read world-readable key files or open PFX files protected by the hard-coded default password to steal private keys.

descriptions.description: Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource

cna.title: Frappe ERPNext before 16.6.0 SQL Injection via Missing Input Validation

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Frappe ERPNext before 16.6.0 SQL Injection via Missing Input Validation

descriptions.value: Frappe ERPNext before 15.98.0 and 16.x before 16.6.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in some endpoints caused by missing input validation. Remote authenticated attackers can send specially crafted requests to the affected endpoints to manipulate database queries and extract sensitive information from the database.

descriptions.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')

cna.title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.112.0 Missing Authorization Allows Arbitrary Record Modification

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Frappe ERPNext before 15.112.0 Missing Authorization Allows Arbitrary Record Modification

descriptions.value: Frappe ERPNext before 15.112.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users with a common operational role to modify records beyond their permissions due to missing validation in certain endpoints. Attackers holding this role can call the affected endpoints to change a field on record types outside their role's permissions, tampering with data they should not control.

cna.title: jshERP through 3.6 Authorization Bypass via User-Controlled Warehouse IDs

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: jshERP through 3.6 Authorization Bypass via User-Controlled Warehouse IDs

descriptions.value: jshERP through 3.6 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read data from unassigned warehouses by supplying depotId or depotIds request parameters. When depot_flag warehouse restriction is enabled, attackers can name arbitrary warehouse ids in endpoints like /depotItem/getMaterialDepotStockByParam to read stock levels, batch numbers, sales figures and priced bill lines within the tenant.

cna.title: Frappe ERPNext before 16.12.0 Stored XSS via Crafted Record Names

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Frappe ERPNext before 16.12.0 Stored XSS via Crafted Record Names

descriptions.value: Frappe ERPNext before 15.103.0 and 16.x before 16.12.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because the names of certain records are not properly neutralized when rendered on some dashboards, tools, and portals. Authenticated attackers can craft malicious record names that execute scripts in other users' browsers, enabling data access, modification, and token theft, especially against privileged users.

descriptions.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

cna.title: Frappe Framework before 16.17.0 Authenticated SSRF and LFI via pdfkit

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Frappe Framework before 16.17.0 Authenticated SSRF and LFI via pdfkit

descriptions.value: Frappe Framework 15.x before 15.107.3 and 16.x before 16.17.0 relies on a vulnerable pdfkit library (CVE-2025-26240) for PDF generation, enabling server-side request forgery and local file inclusion. Authenticated attackers can supply crafted content to PDF rendering to make the server fetch internal resources or embed local server files in generated PDFs.

cna.title: Zebra 2.3.0 before 6.4.0 Peer Ban Bypass via Exact-IP Keying

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Zebra 2.3.0 before 6.4.0 Peer Ban Bypass via Exact-IP Keying

descriptions.value: Zebra 2.3.0 before 6.4.0 contains a protection mechanism failure that allows unauthenticated peers to evade bans because bans and misbehavior scores are keyed on exact IP addresses. Attackers can reconnect from fresh IPv6 addresses in their /64 allocation or flush the 20,000-entry FIFO ban list to restore access for banned peers.

cna.title: FreeRDP 2.0.0-beta1 before 3.28.0 Out-of-Bounds Read via LocateCardsByATRA Handler

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: FreeRDP 2.0.0-beta1 before 3.28.0 Out-of-Bounds Read via LocateCardsByATRA Handler

descriptions.value: FreeRDP from 2.0.0-beta1 before 3.28.0 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in smartcard_LocateCardsByATRA_Call because the ATR pattern cbAtr byte count is not capped. Malicious RDP servers can send crafted ATR mask arrays to use query timing as an oracle, leaking heap memory bit-by-bit to defeat ASLR and aid RCE exploits.

cna.title: FreeRDP 3.27.1 before 3.32.0 NULL Pointer Dereference via Cache Bitmap V3 Order

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: FreeRDP 3.27.1 before 3.32.0 NULL Pointer Dereference via Cache Bitmap V3 Order

descriptions.value: FreeRDP 3.27.1 before 3.32.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference in update_read_cache_bitmap_v3_order() in libfreerdp/core/orders.c, which accesses the client bitmap cache when the CBR3_DO_NOT_CACHE flag is set, even though the cache is not yet initialized before Demand Active. A malicious or compromised RDP server can send a Cache Bitmap V3 order during connection setup to crash a connecting client that has enabled the non-default Bitmap Cache V3 feature (/cache:codec:<rfx|nsc|jpeg>).

cna.title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.110.0 Missing Authorization Allows Unauthorized Status Modification

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Frappe ERPNext before 15.110.0 Missing Authorization Allows Unauthorized Status Modification

descriptions.value: Frappe ERPNext before 15.110.0 and 16.x before 16.21.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in which certain endpoints fail to enforce proper authorization checks on record status changes. Authenticated low-privileged users can call these endpoints to modify data beyond their permitted role, bypassing intended role-based access restrictions.

cna.title: Open WebUI 0.9.0 before 0.11.4 Denial of Service via Recurrence Rule Validation

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Open WebUI 0.9.0 before 0.11.4 Denial of Service via Recurrence Rule Validation

descriptions.value: Open WebUI from 0.9.0 before 0.11.4 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows authenticated users with automations permission to stall the instance by submitting unsatisfiable recurrence rules. Attackers can repeatedly send rules like February 30th to the automations create or update endpoints, blocking the shared event loop for seconds per request.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: LibreNMS before 26.9.0 SQL Injection via notification_id in notifications.inc.php

descriptions.value: LibreNMS before 26.9.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows unprivileged users to inject SQL by supplying an array-valued notification_id parameter to notifications.inc.php. Attackers can perform cross-table reads of users.password hashes, with results persisted in notifications_attribs and readable through the interface.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Vercel deepsec before 1.1.17 Arbitrary File Write via Symlink in Sandbox Tarball Extraction

descriptions.value: Vercel deepsec from 0.1.0 before 1.1.17 contains a link following vulnerability in extractTarballLocally that allows sandboxed code to write files outside the sandbox by planting links in result tarballs. Attackers controlling sandbox code, such as a prompt-injected coding agent, can plant symbolic or hard links in the host data directory to write arbitrary files on the orchestrator host.

descriptions.description: Improper Link Resolution Before File Access ('Link Following')

cna.title: FreeRDP 3.0.0-beta1 before 3.32.0 Stack Buffer Overflow via PKCS#11 Key Name

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: FreeRDP 3.0.0-beta1 before 3.32.0 Stack Buffer Overflow via PKCS#11 Key Name

descriptions.value: FreeRDP 3.0.0-beta1 before 3.32.0 on Unix builds with PKCS#11 support has a stack-based buffer overflow in wprintKeyName() in WinPR's NCrypt PKCS#11 provider. It hex-encodes a key's CKA_ID, which can be up to 64 bytes, into a fixed 128-byte stack buffer. An attacker supplying a malicious PKCS#11 token or module whose key and matching certificate use a 55- to 64-byte CKA_ID can overflow the client's stack during key enumeration, causing a crash.

cna.title: Craft CMS 5.10.2 before 5.10.14 Twig Sandbox Bypass RCE via has some/has every

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Craft CMS 5.10.2 before 5.10.14 Twig Sandbox Bypass RCE via has some/has every

descriptions.value: Craft CMS from 5.10.2 before 5.10.14 contains a Twig sandbox bypass that allows non-admin users to invoke PHP callables through the "has some" and "has every" operators. Users with the System Messages permission can supply two-argument callables such as passthru or system in sandboxed templates to execute code as the web user.

descriptions.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine

cna.title: Grav Guestbook Plugin 0.5.0 and 0.5.1 Missing Authorization and CSRF in Moderation

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Grav Guestbook Plugin 0.5.0 and 0.5.1 Missing Authorization and CSRF in Moderation

descriptions.value: Grav Guestbook plugin 0.5.0 and 0.5.1 contains missing authorization and cross-site request forgery vulnerabilities in Admin moderation actions delete, approve, and approveAll. Authenticated Admin users lacking the admin.guestbook permission, or external sites abusing a moderator's session via nonce-less GET requests, can delete or approve Guestbook entries.

cna.title: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 Information Disclosure in TGA Decoder

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 Information Disclosure in TGA Decoder

descriptions.value: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains an uninitialized memory read in the TGA image decoder that can expose memory contents. Attackers can supply a crafted TGA image for processing to disclose contents of uninitialized memory from the ImageMagick process.

descriptions.description: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

cna.title: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-33 and 6.9.13-58 Heap Buffer Underwrite in PICT Decoder

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-33 and 6.9.13-58 Heap Buffer Underwrite in PICT Decoder

descriptions.value: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-33 and 6.9.13-58 contains a heap buffer underwrite vulnerability in DecodeImage() in coders/pict.c on 32-bit builds due to pointer arithmetic overflow. Attackers can supply a crafted PICT file with maximized row, column and bytes-per-line values to bypass bounds checks and write up to 128 controlled bytes below the heap buffer, causing crashes or code execution.

cna.title: ImageMagick 7.1.0-20 before 7.1.2-32 Use After Free via -fx Option

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: ImageMagick 7.1.0-20 before 7.1.2-32 Use After Free via -fx Option

descriptions.value: ImageMagick 7.1.0-20 before 7.1.2-32 contains a use after free vulnerability in the -fx option that occurs when a memory allocation fails during a specific operation. Attackers who can supply crafted -fx expressions under memory pressure can trigger freed memory access, causing crashes or memory corruption.

Attackers within Bluetooth range can craft commands protected only by a CRC-16/ARC checksum to vibrate the watch and display spoofed alert text for phishing.

cna.title: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 HQL Injection via documents.xml indexed Parameter

Attackers with read access to any folder can inject boolean HQL expressions to bypass folder scope and read-permission checks, listing restricted document metadata and extracting database contents.

cna.title: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-32 TOCTOU Symlink Race Path Policy Bypass via magick script

descriptions.value: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-32 contains a time-of-check time-of-use symlink race vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass the path security policy when executing a magick script. Attackers can swap a checked path with a symlink during script execution to read files that the security policy is meant to block.

cna.title: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 Reachable Assertion via Stale Smartcard Handle

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 Reachable Assertion via Stale Smartcard Handle

descriptions.value: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 does not remove card handles when Emulate_SCardReleaseContext releases a smartcard-emulation context, so Emulate_SCardTransmit later looks up the deleted parent context and reaches a terminating WINPR_ASSERT. A malicious RDP server can crash a connecting client with smartcard emulation and redirection enabled by releasing a context, establishing another, and issuing SCardTransmit with the stale card handle.

cna.title: FreeRDP 3.0.0-beta1 before 3.32.0 Reachable Assertion via Emulated SCardStatusA

A malicious RDP server can send an SCardStatusA request with fmszReaderNamesIsNULL=1 to abort a connecting client.

cna.title: lamp-cloud through 5.10.1 IDOR via /anyone/appendix/listFileByBizId

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: lamp-cloud through 5.10.1 IDOR via /anyone/appendix/listFileByBizId

Attackers can retrieve file names, storage paths, MD5 hashes and stored URLs, which in default LOCAL storage are served without login under /anyTenant/file.

cna.title: MoguBlog through 6.2 Broken Access Control via /networkDisk/getFileList

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: MoguBlog through 6.2 Broken Access Control via /networkDisk/getFileList

descriptions.value: MoguBlog through 6.2 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to list other administrators' network-disk files via POST /networkDisk/getFileList. Attackers can query the endpoint, which filters only by status, file type, or filePath and never by admin_uid, to obtain other administrators' file names and download URLs.

cna.title: SurrealDB before 3.3.0 Cross-Tenant Access via Surreal-NS/Surreal-DB Headers and RPC use

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: SurrealDB before 3.3.0 Cross-Tenant Access via Surreal-NS/Surreal-DB Headers and RPC use

descriptions.value: SurrealDB before 3.3.0 does not check the caller-selected namespace or database against the level at which a namespace- or database-level system user authenticated, allowing cross-tenant access. An authenticated attacker can set the Surreal-NS/Surreal-DB headers on /sql or call the RPC use method to read, create, modify, and delete rows and read DEFINE PARAM values in another tenant where table PERMISSIONS allow it.

A malicious remote can send a 12-byte pack header declaring version 3 to panic the client and abort the clone or fetch.

cna.title: Gnome-remote-desktop: busy-wait dos in vnc tls i/o handlers (gnutls_e_again / gnutls_e_interrupted)

credits.value: Red Hat would like to thank Aisle Research for reporting this issue.

workarounds.value: If VNC is not required, disable the gnome-remote-desktop VNC service. If it must remain enabled, restrict the VNC listener to trusted hosts or management networks using host-based firewall rules.

descriptions.value: A flaw was found in gnome-remote-desktop as shipped in Red Hat Enterprise Linux. In the VNC TLS I/O handlers, retryable GnuTLS results (GNUTLS_E_AGAIN and GNUTLS_E_INTERRUPTED) are handled with an unbounded busy loop instead of yielding to the event loop. A remote attacker who can reach an enabled VNC TLS listener can cause the event-loop thread to spin at high CPU with no forward progress, resulting in denial of service.

descriptions.description: Loop with Unreachable Exit Condition ('Infinite Loop')

cna.x_redhatCweChain: CWE-835: Loop with Unreachable Exit Condition ('Infinite Loop')

descriptions.value: Tink-go (tink-crypto/tink-go) through 2.8.0 contains an input-validation vulnerability where keyset.NewHandleWithNoSecrets() and ReadWithNoSecrets() skip the structural Validate() step before constructing a keyset.Handle, allowing malformed public or no-secret keysets that violate Tink's keyset invariants to be accepted. Attackers can supply a malformed keyset, such as one with an enabled public key lacking a valid primary key or a DESTROYED key with no KeyData, causing inconsistent downstream validation where functions like jwt.JWKSetFromPublicKeysetHandle() process the invalid handle and produce a JWK set, potentially misleading applications that rely on successful handle construction as proof of keyset integrity.

descriptions.value: Frappe ERPNext before 15.106.0 and 16.x before 16.16.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in some endpoints due to missing input validation. Authenticated attackers can send specially crafted requests to inject SQL into database queries and extract sensitive information from the underlying database.

descriptions.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')

cna.title: Use-after-free in the DOM: Streams component

descriptions.value: Use-after-free in the DOM: Streams component. This vulnerability was fixed in Firefox 158, Firefox ESR 115.43, Firefox ESR 153.5, Thunderbird 158, and Thunderbird 153.5.

cna.title: Grav Login Plugin 2.7.0 before 3.9.9 2FA Bypass via Remember-Me Cookie

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Grav Login Plugin 2.7.0 before 3.9.9 2FA Bypass via Remember-Me Cookie

descriptions.value: Grav Login plugin 2.7.0 before 3.9.9 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows attackers with a valid password to skip two-factor authentication through remember-me cookie restoration. Attackers can obtain a persistent remember-me cookie after the password step and restore it as a fully authorized session without completing the second factor.

cna.title: jshERP through 3.6 Approval Bypass via addDepotHeadAndDetail Status Parameter

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: jshERP through 3.6 Approval Bypass via addDepotHeadAndDetail Status Parameter

descriptions.value: jshERP through 3.6 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to create pre-approved bills by setting status in POST /depotHead/addDepotHeadAndDetail requests. Attackers can supply a status of 1 to skip audit permission checks and multi-level approval workflows, creating audited bills that affect stock and report queries.

cna.title: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 Stack Overflow in MVG Decoder

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 Stack Overflow in MVG Decoder

descriptions.value: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains uncontrolled recursion in the MVG decoder that can exhaust the program stack. An attacker who controls a file name processed by ImageMagick can trigger a stack overflow that crashes the process, causing a denial of service.

cna.title: MoguBlog through 6.2 Credential Disclosure via /oauth/getSystemConfig

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: MoguBlog through 6.2 Credential Disclosure via /oauth/getSystemConfig

descriptions.value: MoguBlog through 6.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows low-privileged front-end users to read system credentials via the getSystemConfig endpoint. Attackers can supply an ordinary reader session token to retrieve unfiltered SystemConfig data, exposing Qiniu and MinIO secret keys and SMTP mailbox passwords.

cna.title: fit2cloud MeterSphere Swagger3 Swagger3ParserApiDefinition.java Swagger3ParserApiDefinition.testUrlTimeout server-side request forgery

references.name: VDB-416896 | fit2cloud MeterSphere Swagger3 Swagger3ParserApiDefinition.java Swagger3ParserApiDefinition.testUrlTimeout server-side request forgery
Submit #979788 | FIT2CLOUD MeterSphere v3.6.9-lts (earlier 3.x LTS releases share the same import code path) server-side request forgery (CWE-918)

descriptions.value: A vulnerability was detected in fit2cloud MeterSphere up to 3.6.9-lts. The affected element is the function Swagger3ParserApiDefinition.testUrlTimeout of the file backend/parser/api/dataimport/Swagger3ParserApiDefinition.java of the component Swagger3 Parser. Performing a manipulation of the argument swaggerUrl results in server-side request forgery. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

cna.title: EdgeEver 1.6.0 through 1.112.0 Stored XSS via TemplatesPane Template Preview

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: EdgeEver 1.6.0 through 1.112.0 Stored XSS via TemplatesPane Template Preview

descriptions.value: EdgeEver 1.6.0 through 1.112.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in TemplatesPane.tsx that renders template contentMarkdown with raw HTML via dangerouslySetInnerHTML without sanitization. Attackers can write templates containing HTML event handlers through an API or MCP token to run script on preview and access the privileged window.edgeeverDesktop bridge.

descriptions.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

cna.title: EdgeEver Desktop 1.6.26 through 1.112.0 Navigation Allowlist Bypass via will-navigate

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: EdgeEver Desktop 1.6.26 through 1.112.0 Navigation Allowlist Bypass via will-navigate

descriptions.value: EdgeEver Desktop 1.6.26 through 1.112.0 contains a navigation allowlist bypass that lets attackers load arbitrary origins in the main window via string-prefix URL matching. Attackers can embed a link using userinfo syntax after the dev-server prefix, for example in a note-template preview, to obtain the edgeeverDesktop bridge including session token, sidecar RPC, and ACP channels.

cna.title: Rapyd Admin 9.4.0 before 9.20.0 Stored XSS via select-list Component

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Rapyd Admin 9.4.0 before 9.20.0 Stored XSS via select-list Component

descriptions.value: Rapyd Admin from 9.4.0 before 9.20.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts through self-registered display names. Attackers can register with an HTML or JavaScript name rendered unescaped in the Activity log Author filter, executing in an administrator's session.

descriptions.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 Improper Certificate Validation in freerdp_http_request

descriptions.value: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in freerdp_http_request() in libfreerdp/utils/http.c that completes TLS handshakes without verifying the server certificate chain. On-path attackers can impersonate login.microsoftonline.com in the Azure AD authentication flow to capture OAuth authorization codes and substitute the OpenID discovery document.

cna.title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.119.1 Missing Authorization Allows Unauthorized Document Modification

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Frappe ERPNext before 15.119.1 Missing Authorization Allows Unauthorized Document Modification

descriptions.value: Frappe ERPNext before 15.119.1 and 16.x before 16.32.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability because certain endpoints fail to enforce proper permission checks. Authenticated low-privileged users can call these endpoints to modify documents and data beyond what their assigned role permits.

cna.title: Grav Login Plugin 1.2.0 before 3.9.9 Password Reset Token Disclosure via Reset Page

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Grav Login Plugin 1.2.0 before 3.9.9 Password Reset Token Disclosure via Reset Page

descriptions.value: Grav Login plugin 1.2.0 before 3.9.9 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows publishers to obtain password-reset tokens by authoring a page at the reset route. When a victim opens an emailed reset link, the publisher-controlled page rendered by Login::getPage() exposes the username and bearer token, enabling takeover of more privileged accounts.

descriptions.description: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Frappe ERPNext before 15.121.0 SQL Injection via Unvalidated Endpoints

descriptions.value: Frappe ERPNext before 15.121.0 and 16.x before 16.34.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in some endpoints due to missing input validation. Authenticated attackers with high privileges can send specially crafted requests to these endpoints to inject SQL and extract sensitive information from the database.

descriptions.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')

cna.title: FreeRDP 2.1.0 before 3.32.0 Use-After-Free via rdpsnd Disconnect Path

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: FreeRDP 2.1.0 before 3.32.0 Use-After-Free via rdpsnd Disconnect Path

descriptions.value: FreeRDP 2.1.0 before 3.32.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the static rdpsnd channel disconnect path, which frees audio formats and device without joining play_thread. A malicious RDP server can disconnect while asynchronous Wave2 playback processes queued PDUs, causing the client to read freed heap memory and crash.

cna.title: ZITADEL 3.0.0 before 4.19.2 Account Takeover via SAML Identity-Provider Confusion

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: ZITADEL 3.0.0 before 4.19.2 Account Takeover via SAML Identity-Provider Confusion

descriptions.value: ZITADEL 4.x before 4.19.2 and 3.x through 3.4.15 contains an authentication bypass in the SAML identity-provider intent callback, which verifies the assertion signature using the provider named in the request URL but resolves the user from the login intent without checking they match. Attackers with organization-administrator permission can register a SAML provider with their own signing key to obtain authenticated sessions as any user linked to another SAML provider on the instance, including in other organizations.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Frappe before 16.33.0 Broken Authorization via send_sms Endpoint

descriptions.value: Frappe Framework before 15.120.0 and 16.x before 16.33.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the whitelisted send_sms API endpoint, which does not verify that the caller is permitted to send SMS messages. Users lacking the required permissions can invoke send_sms to send arbitrary SMS messages that impersonate the Company.

cna.title: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-32 Memory Leak via -process Option

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-32 Memory Leak via -process Option

descriptions.value: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-32 contains a memory leak vulnerability in the -process option that allows attackers to cause unreleased memory allocations by supplying certain arguments. Attackers can repeatedly invoke the -process option with crafted arguments to gradually exhaust memory and degrade service availability.

descriptions.description: Missing Release of Memory after Effective Lifetime

cna.title: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 Missing Authorization via ConvertPdf Servlet

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 Missing Authorization via ConvertPdf Servlet

descriptions.value: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the ConvertPdf servlet that allows authenticated users to download restricted PDF documents. Attackers can enumerate sequential docId values and use the version parameter to retrieve any PDF and its versions from folders they cannot access.

cna.title: Thelia before 3.1.2 and 3.2.x before 3.2.1 CSV Formula Injection via Exports

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Thelia before 3.1.2 and 3.2.x before 3.2.1 CSV Formula Injection via Exports

descriptions.value: Thelia before 3.1.2 and 3.2.x before 3.2.1 contains a CSV formula injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated visitors to inject spreadsheet formulas by supplying crafted registration, checkout or newsletter fields. Attackers can submit names, addresses or phone values starting with =, +, - or @ that CSVSerializer exports verbatim, executing formulas in the administrator's spreadsheet application.

descriptions.description: Improper Neutralization of Formula Elements in a CSV File

cna.title: lamp-cloud through 5.10.1 IDOR via /anyone/file/findUrlById

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: lamp-cloud through 5.10.1 IDOR via /anyone/file/findUrlById

descriptions.value: lamp-cloud through 5.10.1 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to obtain storage URLs for other users' files by supplying arbitrary file ids. Attackers can send another user's file ids to the findUrlById handler of FileAnyoneController, which never checks ownership, to retrieve access URLs and read uploaded attachments.

cna.title: Grav Git Sync 1.0.2 through 3.4.12 Command Injection via Commit Author

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Grav Git Sync 1.0.2 through 3.4.12 Command Injection via Commit Author

descriptions.value: Grav Git Sync 1.0.2 through 3.4.12 contains a command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated content editors to execute OS commands by injecting shell substitutions into profile fields. When the gravuser or gravfull author mode is enabled, attackers can set a malicious username, full name, or email that reaches PHP exec() via git commit --author, running commands as the web-server account.

descriptions.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

cna.title: ImageMagick 7.1.1-7 before 7.1.2-32 Heap Buffer Over-Read via XMP Profile

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: ImageMagick 7.1.1-7 before 7.1.2-32 Heap Buffer Over-Read via XMP Profile

descriptions.value: ImageMagick 7.1.1-7 before 7.1.2-32 contains a heap buffer over-read vulnerability that allows attackers to read beyond allocated memory due to incorrect string termination in XMP profiles. Attackers can supply a crafted image containing a malformed XMP profile to trigger the over-read and crash the application.

cna.title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.119.0 Missing Authorization in Transactional Email Endpoints

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Frappe ERPNext before 15.119.0 Missing Authorization in Transactional Email Endpoints

descriptions.value: Frappe ERPNext before 15.119.0 and 16.x before 16.31.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in which certain endpoints fail to verify that the caller may read a document before sending transactional email about it. Authenticated attackers can call these endpoints to trigger transactional email for documents they are not permitted to read.

cna.title: MONAI 0.4.0 before 1.6.1 RCE via SENet Pretrained Weights Over Plaintext HTTP

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: MONAI 0.4.0 before 1.6.1 RCE via SENet Pretrained Weights Over Plaintext HTTP

descriptions.value: MONAI 0.4.0 before 1.6.1 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows on-path attackers to execute code by tampering with SENet pretrained weights fetched over plaintext HTTP. Attackers can substitute a crafted .pth file that load_state_dict_from_url unpickles without weights_only=True, executing code when SEResNet50 or other SENet models are constructed with pretrained=True.

cna.title: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 Insecure Permissions on Soft-Smartcard Private Key File

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 Insecure Permissions on Soft-Smartcard Private Key File

descriptions.value: FreeRDP from 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 contains an incorrect permission assignment vulnerability that allows local users to read private keys written by crypto_write_pem without owner-only permissions. Attackers on multi-user Unix hosts can enumerate the shared temporary directory during soft-smartcard logon to read the world-readable PKINIT private-key copy.

descriptions.description: Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: jshERP through 3.6 Missing Authorization via /log Audit Endpoints

Attackers can supply a crafted PostScript file to expose a single uninitialized byte of memory contents.

cna.title: Crawl4AI 0.7.0 before 0.9.4 SSRF via link_preview_config URL Seeder

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Crawl4AI 0.7.0 before 0.9.4 SSRF via link_preview_config URL Seeder

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.9 SQL Injection via api/autocomplete Search Endpoint

Unauthenticated attackers can send a Unicode right single quotation mark in the search parameter of api/autocomplete, which is normalized to an ASCII quote, to read credentials and configuration secrets, modify records, or drop tables.

cna.title: Hugo v0.60.0 before v0.167.0 Stored XSS via Table of Contents Heading IDs

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Hugo v0.60.0 before v0.167.0 Stored XSS via Table of Contents Heading IDs

Attackers can break out of the unescaped href attribute in .TableOfContents or .Fragments.ToHTML output to inject elements with event handlers into rendered pages.

descriptions.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

cna.title: SurrealDB before 3.3.0 Denial of Service via Headers Non-ASCII Values

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: SurrealDB before 3.3.0 Denial of Service via Headers Non-ASCII Values

descriptions.value: SurrealDB before 3.3.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows query-capable users to crash the server by reading non-ASCII header values in embedded JavaScript. Attackers with scripting enabled can read such values via Headers get(), entries(), values(), or getSetCookie(), or return them from fetch() endpoints, aborting the server process.

cna.title: SurrealDB 3.1.0 before 3.3.0 Authorization Bypass via REFERENCE ON DELETE CASCADE

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: SurrealDB 3.1.0 before 3.3.0 Authorization Bypass via REFERENCE ON DELETE CASCADE

descriptions.value: SurrealDB from 3.1.0 before 3.3.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to delete protected graph edges by triggering a REFERENCE ON DELETE CASCADE. Attackers with delete permission on a referenced table can delete a record whose cascade disables permission checks for edge cleanup, erasing edges despite the edge table's PERMISSIONS FOR delete clause.

cna.title: SiYuan v3.7.0 before v3.8.6 Arbitrary File Read via Plugin ResponseFile.Path

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: SiYuan v3.7.0 before v3.8.6 Arbitrary File Read via Plugin ResponseFile.Path

descriptions.value: SiYuan v3.7.0 before v3.8.6 contains an absolute path traversal vulnerability in the kernel's private plugin HTTP server, which passes a kernel plugin handler's ResponseFile.Path to gin's Context.File without validation. Attackers supplying a malicious kernel plugin can return an absolute path to read any file readable by the SiYuan process, including the API token and conf.json.

descriptions.description: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

cna.title: Network-AI 5.0.0 before 5.15.2 Cross-Site WebSocket Hijacking via DashboardServer

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Network-AI 5.0.0 before 5.15.2 Cross-Site WebSocket Hijacking via DashboardServer

descriptions.value: Network-AI 5.0.0 before 5.15.2 contains a cross-site WebSocket hijacking vulnerability in DashboardServer that allows remote attackers to read live agent topology because handleUpgrade performs no Origin or token validation. Attackers can lure a victim running the dashboard to a malicious page that opens a WebSocket to the loopback dashboard and exfiltrates agent IDs, roles, task descriptions, and token budgets.

cna.title: yshop-crm through 2.1.3 Missing Authorization via invoice check endpoint

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: yshop-crm through 2.1.3 Missing Authorization via invoice check endpoint

The CrmInvoiceController check handler lacks @PreAuthorize and approver checks are commented out, letting attackers bypass the invoice approval workflow by supplying any invoice id.

descriptions.value: Pimcore through 2026.3.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated backend users to inject scripts by storing unescaped URLs in ExternalImage fields. cna.title: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 heap buffer overflow via license_check_stream_length

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 heap buffer overflow via license_check_stream_length

descriptions.value: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 contains an integer truncation vulnerability in license_check_stream_length that allows a malicious RDP server to trigger a heap buffer overflow on 32-bit clients. Attackers can send a crafted SERVER_LICENSE_REQUEST with a large scopeCount that bypasses length checks, causing out-of-bounds writes leading to denial of service or remote code execution.

cna.title: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 Username Enumeration via AvatarServlet

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 Username Enumeration via AvatarServlet

descriptions.value: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 contains a username enumeration vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to identify valid accounts because the AvatarServlet (/avatar) performs no session validation. Attackers can supply usernames or numeric IDs in the userId parameter and compare 1x1 transparent images against real avatars to enumerate users and retrieve profile pictures.

Authenticated control panel users with the performUpdates permission or Updates-utility access can supply 'as' or 'on' keys, such as an AttributeTypecastBehavior gadget, to execute arbitrary code.

cna.title: NetEase Cloud Music Weak Encryption via eapi/xeapi

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: NetEase Cloud Music Weak Encryption via eapi/xeapi

descriptions.value: NetEase Cloud Music client for Windows (cloudmusic.exe) versions 3.1.38 and 3.1.39.205426 contains a weak encryption vulnerability where /eapi/ and /xeapi/ API response bodies are decrypted using a fixed, publicly documented AES-128-ECB key with no integrity credential. Attackers who can intercept or originate server responses can construct valid ciphertext under the known key with PKCS#7 padding, enabling the client to accept forged API responses that serve as a prerequisite for further exploitation such as reaching the os.navigateExternal bridge.

descriptions.value: In HAProxy Data Plane API 2.2.0 through 3.4.3 (and corresponding Enterprise Edition releases), Server.ConfigureAPI() has process-global authentication logic that improperly drops security controls across multiple transport types. When a TLS Certificate Authority (tls_ca) is configured and a numeric TLS port (tls_port) is specified, the application globally disables Basic authentication on its shared internal request handler. Because this handler is shared concurrently among HTTP, HTTPS, and UNIX domain socket listeners, and mutual TLS (mTLS) client certificate verification (tls.RequireAndVerifyClientCert) is enforced exclusively on the HTTPS server path, all other simultaneously active non-mTLS listeners fail open. Consequently, an unauthenticated attacker capable of reaching an affected HTTP or UNIX management endpoint can completely bypass credentials to gain full API administrative access. This allows unauthorized remote or local actors to read sensitive, cleartext HAProxy configuration data or replace the managed configuration entirely via the raw configuration endpoint. This has been fixed in versions 3.4.4, 3.3.9, 3.2.17, 3.0.25, 2.9.29, and their respective EE backports by migrating to a per-request TLS connection-state validation model.

descriptions.description: CWE-306 Missing Authentication for Critical Function

descriptions.value: FreeRDP from 3.9.0 before 3.32.0 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the RDPEAR NDR scalar readers, which check value length before consuming alignment padding. cna.title: Nezha 2.0.10 through 2.3.2 SSRF Denylist Bypass IPv6

descriptions.value: Nezha versions 2.0.10 through 2.3.2 use a restricted HTTP client to validate user-configurable notification and DDNS webhook URLs, but the denylist did not cover IPv6 transition ranges — specifically the 6to4 prefix 2002::/16 and the local-use IPv4/IPv6 translation prefix 64:ff9b:1::/48. Because such addresses satisfy Go's netip.Addr.IsGlobalUnicast check, the URL validator accepted them. An authenticated user able to configure a webhook may be able to cause the dashboard to issue requests to an otherwise restricted IPv6 endpoint, but only where the dashboard's network provides unusual or non-standards-compliant routing for these transition ranges; no direct path to an IPv4 metadata, loopback, or private-network HTTP request has been demonstrated. The issue is fixed in version 2.3.3 (commit d1fcde8e), which blocks both prefixes.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Nezha 2.0.10 through 2.3.2 SSRF Denylist Bypass IPv6

cna.title: @grpc/grpc-js: The exact path match matcher incorrectly only applies a prefix match for case-insensitive matches

descriptions.value: @grpc/grpc-js implements the core functionality of gRPC purely in JavaScript, without a C++ addon. Prior to 1.13.1 and 1.14.1, the exact path (method name) matcher used by RBAC performs a prefix comparison instead of an equality comparison when case-insensitive matching is enabled. If one service method name prefixes another and the methods have different access rules, a request for the longer method can match the shorter method's rule and cause incorrect authorization. This issue is fixed in versions 1.13.1 and 1.14.1.

cna.title: WP Ultimate Review < 2.4.4 - Unauthenticated DoS via Non-Numeric Review Rating

descriptions.value: The WP Ultimate Review WordPress plugin before 2.4.4 does not validate that a submitted review rating is numeric before storing it and later using it in numeric operations when rendering reviews, allowing unauthenticated users to make the reviewed content fail with a fatal error for all visitors until the review is removed (a persistent denial of service), when user reviews are enabled.

In Eclipse BaSyx AAS Web UI versions v2-241220 through releases before v2-260924, the shared request handler attached the selected infrastructure's `Authorization` header to outgoing requests without checking the destination origin. In deployments using authentication, an attacker could induce a user to open a crafted Web UI link whose `aas` or `path` query parameter points to an attacker-controlled endpoint. The user's browser would then send the configured Basic Authentication credentials, Bearer token, or an available OAuth2 access token to that endpoint. The attacker could reuse the disclosed credential to access protected AAS services with the victim's privileges. The issue is fixed in v2-260924.

cna.title: Nezha through 2.2.3 Host Header Injection via OAuth2 redirect_uri

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Nezha through 2.2.3 Host Header Injection via OAuth2 redirect_uri

descriptions.value: Nezha 2.2.3 contains a Host header injection regression in the OAuth2 redirect endpoint. When the new optional dashboard_host setting is empty, /api/v1/oauth2/{provider} (cmd/dashboard/controller/oauth2.go) reflects the attacker-supplied HTTP Host header into the redirect_uri sent to the identity provider instead of falling back to the configured install_host. An attacker who induces a victim to begin OAuth2 login via a request that reaches Nezha with a forged Host header can cause an attacker-controlled callback URL to be used as the redirect_uri; if the OAuth2 provider accepts it, the victim's authorization code is delivered to the attacker origin, allowing the attacker to complete the OAuth2 login/binding flow and take over the account. This regresses the fix for GHSA-9rc6-8cjv-rcvx and is configuration-dependent (dashboard_host empty). At the time of the advisory no patched version was available.

cna.title: Ash.count, Ash.exists and Ash.aggregate skip related resources' read policies in filters and sorts

descriptions.value: CAPEC-1 Accessing Functionality Not Properly Constrained by ACLs

Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in ash-project ash allows an actor to infer data in related records they cannot read via Ash.count/2, Ash.exists/2 and Ash.aggregate/3.

Ash.Actions.Aggregate.run/4 (lib/ash/actions/aggregate.ex) applied only the root resource's read policy before running the aggregate query. The read path also applies each related resource's read policy to filter and sort references that cross a relationship, directly (for example comments.body) or through an aggregate over one, but the aggregate path skipped that step. A caller whose filter or sort reaches these functions, for example through Ash.Query.filter_input/2, an ash_lua script, or an AshAi tool offering count or exists results, can test conditions against related rows hidden from them and recover their existence and attribute values one query at a time. Ash.read/2 and its page counts are not affected.

This issue affects ash: from 2.6.0 before 3.34.6.

descriptions.value: Axios is a promise-based HTTP client for the browser and Node.js. From 1.12.0 until 1.20.0, ResolveConfig reads inherited Symbol.toStringTag, append, and getHeaders properties while resolving FormData headers. A separate same-process prototype-pollution flaw supplies an array or non-plain class instance whose inherited properties make it appear FormData-like; plain objects are blocked. The inherited getHeaders function can return attacker-controlled headers that resolveConfig merges into a fetch adapter request. Attacker-controlled headers can alter authorization, cache, metadata-service, or application-specific request behavior. This issue is fixed in version 1.20.0.

descriptions.value: Axios is a promise-based HTTP client for the browser and Node.js. From 1.13.0 until 1.20.0, Http2Sessions does not install adequate error handling for a ClientHttp2Session during Axios HTTP/2 session initialization or reuse. A request uses httpVersion: 2 and the ClientHttp2Session emits an error during session initialization or reuse. The unhandled session error escapes normal Promise rejection handling. cna.title: pacquet before 12.0.0-alpha.5 Path Traversal via lockfile alias

descriptions.value: pacquet, the Rust package-manager component shipped in the pnpm npm package versions >=12.0.0-alpha.0 and <12.0.0-alpha.5, does not validate dependency alias/name paths taken from a lockfile before using them in install-time filesystem joins. When a user installs a project with an attacker-supplied lockfile using --trust-lockfile or a frozen lockfile, alias entries containing path traversal segments (for example '../../escaped-link') are used when creating dependency and package links, bin destinations, hoisted entries, and virtual-store slots, allowing symlinks and directories to be created outside the intended project and node_modules boundary. Version 12.0.0-alpha.5 validates dependency names and every virtual-store slot path with a shared safe-join containment helper before any filesystem materialization, rejecting traversal, absolute, platform-specific, and reserved names with ERR_PNPM_INVALID_DEPENDENCY_NAME.

cna.title: Obot Quickstart Docker Deployment Unauthenticated Admin Access

descriptions.value: Obot is an open-source AI agent/MCP platform. In all versions up to and including commit d7e6970, the Docker quickstart command documented in the README starts the container listening on 0.0.0.0:8080 with authentication disabled by default. When authentication is disabled, every request is mapped to a synthetic "nobody" user that holds the Owner and Admin roles, so any unauthenticated party who can reach the exposed port obtains full administrative access to the Obot API and UI, including the ability to register and launch attacker-controlled MCP servers. Because the quickstart also mounts /var/run/docker.sock into the container, the MCP runtime backend reachable this way has access to the host's Docker control surface. The fix is documentation-only: the quickstart now enables authentication, and operators who followed the previous instructions should set OBOT_SERVER_ENABLE_AUTHENTICATION=true before exposing the host to any untrusted network.

cna.title: Parse Server 9.0.0 Authentication Bypass via Unverified Provider Identity

descriptions.value: Parse Server is an open-source backend server. In versions >= 9.0.0 < 9.10.1-alpha.10 and >= 8.0.2 < 8.6.91, the code-based authentication adapters (GitHub, Google Play Games, Instagram, LINE, LinkedIn, Microsoft, QQ, Spotify, WeChat, Weibo) verify the client's authorization code with the external provider on signup and on provider linking, but not when authentication data is supplied together with a username and password on the login endpoint. As a result, a low-privileged authenticated user can attach an arbitrary, unverified provider identity to their own account without the provider ever being contacted, spoofing an external identity toward application logic that trusts the linked provider ID. An attacker can also pre-hijack accounts: by claiming the provider ID of a victim who has not yet linked that provider, the victim's later legitimate sign-in with that provider resolves to the attacker's account. Only deployments configuring one of the affected code-based auth adapters are impacted. Versions 9.10.1-alpha.10 and 8.6.91 fix the issue by running the adapter's credential verification on the login and challenge endpoints and rejecting a provider identity already linked to another user. As a workaround, disable the affected code-based auth adapters.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Parse Server 9.0.0 Authentication Bypass via Unverified Provider Identity

cna.title: @xhmikosr/decompress: Path traversal via symlink chain

descriptions.value: The decompress package for Node.js extracts archives. Prior to 10.2.2 and 11.1.4, the default decompress(input, output) API relies on lexical containment checks that do not account for the kernel following a planted symlink chain. An attacker can supply a crafted archive containing chained symlink entries so that a later entry resolves outside the output directory. This allows files outside output to be read or written, and overwriting startup scripts or configuration can lead to remote code execution. The maintained @xhmikosr/decompress package is fixed in 10.2.2 and 11.1.4, but the separately affected unmaintained decompress package remains unpatched through 4.2.1. This vulnerability results from a bypass of the incomplete hardening for CVE-2026-53486. @xhmikosr/decompress is fixed in versions 10.2.2 and 11.1.4.

cna.title: ip-address: Address6 builds a parse diagnostic proportional to the input with no length bound, allowing a single long string to stall or crash the process

descriptions.value: ip-address is a library for parsing and manipulating IPv4 and IPv6 addresses in JavaScript. Prior to 10.7.1, the Address6 constructor, Address6.isValid, and parse code in src/ipv6.ts accept unbounded strings and expand invalid characters through RE_BAD_CHARACTERS into large diagnostics. Material impact occurs only when an application accepts a very large attacker-controlled field and passes it to Address6 parsing without an earlier length bound. Common URL and header limits, and common body-parser defaults, generally constrain the effect; common defaults typically exclude 32 MiB fields. Megabyte-scale fields can cause a synchronous stall and high transient memory use, approximately 16 MiB can trigger an invalid string length exception, and process termination occurs at approximately 32 MiB. The affected entry points include Address6.isValid and construction paths that reach parse. This issue is fixed in version 10.7.1.

descriptions.value: Nezha is a server and website monitoring tool. In versions >= 2.2.11 and < 2.3.1, the service sentinel worker (service/singleton/servicesentinel.go) contains an incomplete fix for a previously reported nil dereference denial of service (GHSA-qjpp-gffx-2wm9). The 2026-07-21 fix re-validated the service lifecycle under serviceResponseDataStoreLock but reused an already-captured, now stale reporter pointer and never re-validated the server, and that lock does not guard ServerShared. An authenticated user with the member role who owns an agent can issue a concurrent server delete (POST /api/v1/batch-delete/server) for their own server to win the race window, causing the worker to dereference a missing entry in the server list snapshot. Because the sentinel workers and the gRPC server have no recover()/recovery interceptor, the resulting panic is unrecovered and crashes the entire instance. This is fixed in version 2.3.1.
